author: reek
body: Reusable board layout fragments. A design block is a saved collection of tracks, vias, footprints, and zones that can be instantiated into a board at a given position and rotation. Useful for repeating proven sub-circuits such as decoupling clusters or matched differential pair breakouts.

author: reek
body: The ref-pattern field uses a wildcard such as "U?" or "C?" so that instances receive auto-numbered reference designators when placed.
